About

I'm a rising sophomore studying Biomedical Engineering and Electrical & Computer Engineering at Duke University and am passionate about leveraging medical device design, translational medicine, and computational biology in addressing patient needs. As a dedicated researcher at a number of institutions, and a leader in my professional community, I take great pride in the 3 core principles: leadership, diligence, and empathy which drives me to advance healthcare technologies.
